headline: SUPPLY and its exact WITHDRAW closure succeeded, but the declared looping lifecycle stopped before BORROW because the funding plan did not reserve enough native gas for the action sequence.

A_act: Action-density required SUPPLY→BORROW→SWAP→SUPPLY→BORROW, but only SUPPLY executed; this directly fails the Strategy contract even though the initiating cause was harness gas planning.
A1: Four observed SUPPLY/teardown transactions were unique status-1 receipts, but the Uniswap path and full receipt artifact contract were not exercised.
A2: Positive USDC collateral existed, but BORROW was never submitted, so positive USDT debt and the requested health-factor state were never established.
A3: A separate graceful teardown found the one open SUPPLY position, executed one status-1 WITHDRAW, and proved it closed on chain.
A4: No debt-bearing withdrawal or swap occurred, so the health-floor and swap-guard obligations were not exercised.
A5: Pinned block 495359016 proves USDC/USDT aToken and debt balances, collateral, and debt are all zero; USDC is consolidated at 3,999,999 raw before sweep.
A6: Immutable SQLite records successful SUPPLY and WITHDRAW rows, the failed unsubmitted BORROW, exact transaction linkage, principal deltas, measured gas, and preserves unmeasured SUPPLY interest as null.
A7: Only an early Dashboard screenshot exists; pre-teardown and terminal Dashboard observations are missing.
A_cap: The 0.0001 ETH rescue top-up remained inside the approved $1 gas/$5 wallet caps; 3.999999 USDC was swept and wallet #12 released.

findings: The funding planner's cap PASS did not establish action-sequence gas feasibility; the second intended action was short 1018506834000 wei and never submitted.
A pre-submission insufficient-funds rejection with txs_sent=0 was labeled BROADCAST_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED as though the submission boundary had been crossed.
Only the early Dashboard phase was captured; no pre-teardown or terminal view is available.
The command journal retained only initialization, so the closeout is not CLEAN conductor provenance.
Aave SUPPLY and WITHDRAW still use the legacy VIB-5218 money-leg fallback.
deviations: Whole-wallet cap validation did not reserve gas for the complete required runtime and teardown sequence.
TICKET-NEEDED: add sequence-aware gas feasibility to funding plans
A before-submission insufficient-funds error is misclassified as broadcast reconciliation required.
TICKET-NEEDED: distinguish pre-submission rejection from ambiguous broadcast
All four strategy receipts, the rescue top-up, and the sweep are retained as raw transaction/receipt JSON.
PRESERVE: keep raw chain artifacts mandatory for closeout
hold: none; graceful teardown was requested immediately after BORROW failed
money_note: 4 USDC supplied and 3.999999 USDC withdrawn; 0.000001 USDC principal difference plus native gas.
